purpose: Contract-level decision vectors only; no current runtime evaluator or order path consumes these scenarios.

scenarios.rationale: The complete sourced bearish 4h/1h regime, 15m confirmation, 5m execution cascade and 1m timing hypothesis is present; pass means hypothesis match only, never execution approval.
A bearish 1m print without the strict 4h/1h bearish context is not crash_short and must not degrade into an RSI-only signal.
The sourced 5m RSI floor rejects an already exhausted terminal tick even when lower-timeframe price and volume look bearish.
A retest followed by an observed bearish resumption is not canonical until #303 defines a typed resumption condition and #304 supplies a compatible risk/order envelope.
The legacy bullish pullback readiness signal alone has no bearish-resumption evidence and the redundant subset cannot create a second setup identity.
